status_evidence: kaffilaugalaekur.is is live with a 26 menu PDF, a Dineout booking link and a brunch menu. It is a cafe and restaurant with pizzas ("Bökur"/flatbökur) as one section. The site shows hours Sun–Mon 10:00–22:00 and Tue–Sun 10:00–23:00 (overlapping on Sunday) and no direct sign of recent posts, so open is inferred from the live 2026 menu rather than a dated post. Instagram and Facebook are linked from the site; I did not read them.

sources.note: Icelandic menu PDF "Matseðill íslenska 26", redirects to squarespace static. It lists the pizzas ("Bökur") with prices. It carries no date stamp.

items.name: LitlaGulaHænan
items.desc_is: Flatbaka með kjúkling og beikoni, grænu pestó, osti og pítsasósu. Toppuð með salati, pikkluðum skarlottulauk, kirsuberja- tómötum, hvítlauksósu og parmesan.

items.name: Pylsumeistarinn
items.desc_is: Flatbaka með pylsum, beikoni, pepperoni, sveppum, lauk, sósu og osti.

items.name: Chorizohálfmáni
items.desc_is: Fylltur með osti, kryddpylsu, pikkluðum eldpipar, hvítlaukssmjöri. Toppaður með parmesan osti, grænu pestói og salati til hliðar.

items.name: Geiteyjarströnd
items.desc_is: Flatbaka með taðreyktum silung ásamt pikkluðum skarlottulauk, piparrótarsósu, soðnu eggi, grænu pestó, dill og fersku salati.

items.name: Ostapizza
items.desc_is: Flatbaka með Brie, gráðosti, mozzarella, pikkluðum lauk og hesilhnetum.

items.name: Barnabaka (children's menu, 12 and under)
items.note: no description given on the menu

not_found: no delivery-platform check. I did not check the Brunch PDF for pizzas. The monthly special is not on the menu PDF, so it may exist only as a board or social post. The site's opening hours conflict with themselves.
